messages.subject: Hey guys, how to write commands in R to render the nodes into 50 different colors using color codes？
messages.subject_clean: Hey guys, how to write commands in R to render the nodes into 50 different colors using color codes？
messages.body_plain:
Hey guys,

I have a network of 6469 nodes and 62146 edges, these nodes are gene names from around 50 plant species, I want to color them into different colors, it's not so convenient to use vizmapper and choose colors one by one.
So I was wondering how can I use R to write some commands and give nodes from same species a color code. I have already prepared the color codes but don't know how can I map these colors to the nodes based on their node attributes.

Thank you very much!!

Happy 2015.

Tao

27-12-14

Thanks!

 - Paul
